## FSM Path-Based Representations Test Suite for U05_Alarms

**States:**

* ALARM_INACTIVE
* ALARM_ACTIVE
* ALARM_INHIBITED
* ALARM_ACKNOWLEDGED
* ALARM_CANCELLED
* ALARM_RESET

**Transitions:**

* START -> ALARM_INACTIVE
* ALARM_INACTIVE -> ALARM_ACTIVE (trigger alarm)
* ALARM_ACTIVE -> ALARM_INHIBITED (inhibit alarm)
* ALARM_ACTIVE -> ALARM_ACKNOWLEDGED (acknowledge alarm)
* ALARM_ACTIVE -> ALARM_CANCELLED (cancel alarm)
* ALARM_ACTIVE -> ALARM_RESET (reset alarm)

**Test Paths:**

**Path 1:** Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm -> Acknowledge alarm -> Cancel alarm -> Reset alarm

**Path 2:** Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm -> Acknowledge alarm -> Cancel alarm -> Reset alarm -> Trigger alarm

**Path 3:** Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm -> Acknowledge alarm -> Cancel alarm -> Reset alarm -> Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm

**Path 4:** Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm -> Acknowledge alarm -> Cancel alarm -> Reset alarm -> Trigger alarm -> Acknowledge alarm

**Path 5:** Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm -> Acknowledge alarm -> Cancel alarm -> Reset alarm -> Trigger alarm -> Cancel alarm

**Path 6:** Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm -> Acknowledge alarm -> Cancel alarm -> Reset alarm -> Trigger alarm -> Reset alarm

**Path 7:** Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm -> Acknowledge alarm -> Cancel alarm -> Reset alarm -> Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm -> Acknowledge alarm

**Path 8:** Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm -> Acknowledge alarm -> Cancel alarm -> Reset alarm -> Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm -> Cancel alarm

**Path 9:** Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm -> Acknowledge alarm -> Cancel alarm -> Reset alarm -> Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm -> Reset alarm

**Path 10:** Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm -> Acknowledge alarm -> Cancel alarm -> Reset alarm -> Trigger alarm -> Inhibit alarm -> Reset alarm -> Trigger alarm
